1. What they realized in the Babylonian Exile
 - After Jeremiah, the book of Daniel records how the Jews taken captive to Babylon lived there, what happened there and how it unfolded, what it meant, what God's purpose was in it and what came of it, and what they realized there, what they learned, and what changed in them.

2. The structure of Daniel

그래서 이 초강대국 두 나라가 계속 150년간 싸우는 틈새에서 이스라엘: So chapter 11 is the story showing how much the people of Israel would suffer in the gap while these two superpowers kept fighting for 150 years.
우리 레위기 26장에 그런 얘기 나오죠? 계속 말 안들으면 하늘이 철이되: Leviticus chapter 26 says something like that, right? If you keep disobeying, the heavens will become iron and the earth brass
Then what happens to someone stuck in between? They get flattened...
하나님 섬기기 귀찮다고 한 이스라엘 백성들이 ‘그래? 그럼 이방 나라 한: The people of Israel said serving God was a hassle, so: ‘Oh yeah? Then try serving a foreign nation.’
150년 동안 두 강대국 사이에서 멧돌질을 당하는거에요. 이걸 다니엘이: For 150 years they get ground in a millstone between two superpowers. Daniel saw this ahead of time.
From then on, the Jews and serving foreign gods? They put a complete end to it.
They serve only the LORD God. And so they don't believe in Jesus either.
